en-US.subtitle: Encrypted chat, your own keys
en-US.description:
A messenger with no company in the middle.

Your account is a twelve-word recovery phrase held on your device. There is no sign-up, no phone number, no email address, and no account on a server that could be seized, sold or breached.

FIVE NETWORKS, ONE INBOX
• End-to-end encrypted one-to-one and group chats over XMTP, Nostr or Waku
• Your own Telegram and Matrix accounts in the same list, signed in with your own credentials
• A Matrix server running a bridge brings WhatsApp, Signal, Slack or iMessage along with it
• Every conversation says which network it is on and what that network actually protects. Telegram is not end-to-end encrypted, and the app says so on the chat.

MESSAGING
• Message requests, folders, search, replies, reactions, forwarding, pin, archive and mute
• Photos, files, GIFs and voice notes
• Links unfurl into a card fetched by your device, not by a server, and you can switch that off
• No last seen and no typing indicator, on any network, on purpose

THE SAME PHRASE IS A WALLET
• Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, Bitcoin and Solana
• Check a balance, send, swap or bridge, ask someone to pay you, or split a bill inside the conversation where it came up
• Every send and every signature shows a review step first, and nothing is signed until you confirm
• Connect a Ledger, Trezor or Keystone and the key never touches this phone

STARTS EMPTY, BY DESIGN
A new install is a messenger and nothing else. The wallet, market alerts, the dapp browser and bots are plugins that ship switched off. Each one says what it adds and what it is allowed to reach before you turn it on.

NO ACCOUNTS, NO KEYS
The app ships with no API keys of its own. Where a feature needs one you supply it, and it stays on your device. Your address book is read on the device to suggest who to invite and is never uploaded.

WHAT THIS COSTS YOU
Nobody can reset your account. Write the twelve words down and keep them offline. If you lose them, they are gone. That is what having no company in the middle means.
en-US.promoText: Encrypted messaging where the account is a key you hold. No phone number, no email, no server with your name on it.
